tools.name: set_node_properties
tools.title: Set node properties
tools.description: Update properties of a Dynamo node on canvas: rename/nickname, freeze state, 3D geometry preview visibility, input value (slider, string, boolean), or canvas coordinates. Modifies active graph workspace with undo recording. [Registry tool v1, Node, transaction=auto. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Dynamo — prefer them over execute_dynamo_code for the same task.]

nodeId.description: GUID string or current name/nickname of the target node

name.description: New custom nickname or title for the node

value.description: New value string for input nodes (e.g. number slider value, string text, boolean 'true'/'false', or CodeBlock script)

isFrozen.description: Set execution freeze state (true to freeze execution, false to unfreeze)

isVisible.description: Set 3D geometry preview visibility (true to show preview in background, false to hide)

dryRun.description: Run the tool, then roll everything back. Use first on a model you care about.

tools.name: search_nodes_library
tools.title: Search Dynamo nodes library
tools.description: Searches the loaded Dynamo node library across built-in core nodes, Revit nodes, DesignScript functions, and third-party packages matching a query keyword or category filter. [Registry tool v1, Library, transaction=none. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Dynamo — prefer them over execute_dynamo_code for the same task.]

query.description: Search keyword matching node name, description, or full type signature (e.g. 'Rebar', 'Point', 'Wall', 'List.Map')

category.description: Optional category prefix or namespace to filter results (e.g. 'Revit.Elements', 'Geometry.Points')

maxResults.description: Maximum number of search results to return (clamped between 1 and 200)

tools.name: get_active_graph_info
tools.title: Get active Dynamo graph info
tools.description: Inspects the currently open Dynamo graph in the active workspace, reporting file path, name, total node and connector counts, run settings (Manual vs Automatic), custom node definitions, error status, and unsaved changes. [Registry tool v1, Workspace, transaction=none. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Dynamo — prefer them over execute_dynamo_code for the same task.]

includeNodeList.description: Include summarized list of all nodes in workspace (id, name, type, state, port counts)

includeErrors.description: Include detailed error messages and warnings from nodes currently in error or warning state

tools.name: get_run
tools.title: Get a past run
tools.description: Details of one run from the history (runId comes back from the execute tool, run_tool and test_tool): outcome, args, the code when it was a successful ad-hoc script, and — when the host application is reachable — an analysis listing hard-coded literals (line, value, variable) and the args keys already read. Use it before propose_tool to decide which literals become parameters.

analyze.description: Analyse the code (guard, compile, literals) through the host application

tools.name: get_dynamo_context
tools.title: Get Dynamo context
tools.description: Returns the current Dynamo and Revit session status: hostVersion, active document title and path, isReadOnly, isModifiable, units, openDocs, executionEnabled, and dynamo facts {isLive, dynamoVersion, activeWorkspaceName, activeWorkspacePath, runType (Automatic, Manual, Periodic), nodeCount, wireCount, selectedNodeCount, hasUnsavedChanges}. With includeSelection, returns currently selected nodes and elements. Call this before script execution.

includeSelection.description: Include currently selected nodes or elements in Dynamo canvas (id, category, name).

tools.name: disconnect_node_ports
tools.title: Disconnect node ports
tools.description: Disconnect wire(s) connected to a specific input or output port of a Dynamo node on canvas, or sever a specific connection between two nodes. Modifies active graph workspace with undo recording. [Registry tool v1, Wire, transaction=auto. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Dynamo — prefer them over execute_dynamo_code for the same task.]

nodeId.description: GUID string or title/name of the primary node whose port to disconnect

portIndex.description: 0-based port index on the specified node (default 0)

portType.description: Type of port to disconnect: 'input' (in-port) or 'output' (out-port)

targetNodeId.description: Optional GUID string or name of the connected target/source node to disconnect from. If omitted, all wires on the specified port are disconnected.

targetPortIndex.description: Optional 0-based port index on the target node

dryRun.description: Run the tool, then roll everything back. Use first on a model you care about.

tools.name: cancel_execution
tools.title: Cancel running script
tools.description: Signals cancellation to the script currently running in the host application. Cancellation is cooperative: the script stops at its next `ct` check, and its transaction group is rolled back. Returns whether anything was running.

tools.name: get_node_output_values
tools.title: Get node output values
tools.description: Retrieve computed evaluation values and cached mirror data from output ports of specified nodes or all active nodes after graph execution. Read-only. [Registry tool v1, Data, transaction=none. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Dynamo — prefer them over execute_dynamo_code for the same task.]

nodeIds.description: Optional list of node GUIDs or names to query. If omitted or empty, queries all nodes in the workspace.

includeGeometry.description: If true, extracts detailed geometric coordinates and measurements rather than short string summaries

limit.description: Maximum number of nodes to inspect (1-200, default 50)

tools.name: run_tool
tools.title: Run a registry tool
tools.description: Run a stored tool from the registry with the given args (must match its inputSchema from search_tools / get_tool). Same result shape as the execute tool. Draft / tested / pending tools need allowUnpublished=true. Use dryRun=true first for tools that modify the document.

allowUnpublished.description: Allow running a tool that is not published yet

tools.name: create_code_block_node
tools.title: Create Code Block node
tools.description: Create a DesignScript Code Block node on the active Dynamo canvas workspace with specified script code, position (X, Y), and parse syntax. Modifies active graph workspace with undo recording. [Registry tool v1, CodeBlock, transaction=auto. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Dynamo — prefer them over execute_dynamo_code for the same task.]

code.description: DesignScript code statements for the code block (e.g. 'x = 100; y = 200; Point.ByCoordinates(x, y, 0);')

x.description: X coordinate for placement on canvas (default 100.0)

y.description: Y coordinate for placement on canvas (default 100.0)

title.description: Optional custom nickname or title for the Code Block node

dryRun.description: Run the tool, then roll everything back. Use first on a model you care about.

tools.name: propose_tool
tools.title: Propose a new registry tool
tools.description: Package a working C# script as a reusable tool (status draft). Replace every literal that may change between calls with args.<Kind>("key") and declare each key in inputSchema (JSON Schema object: string/number/integer/boolean/array/object, required, default, description). The code is guard-checked and compiled inside the host application but not run. Give ≥ 2 examples with different args; test_tool runs them. Returns a validation report; fix errors and call again. Use newVersion=true to replace the code of an existing tool.

description.description: What the tool does, for search and for the reviewer (≥ 20 chars)

category.description: One of the host's categories (search_tools lists them): Architecture | Structure | MEP | Annotation | View | Data | Generic for Revit, Drawing | Layer | Block | Annotation | Layout | Data | Generic for AutoCAD

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema of the args object

code.description: Script body: same globals as the execute tool plus args; must end with return

title.description: Human title, e.g. 'Colour beams by type'

transaction.description: auto (the bridge wraps the run in a transaction) | manual (Revit: the code opens its own Transaction; AutoCAD: same as auto) | none (read-only)

sourceRunId.description: runId of the execute run this comes from (see get_run)

newVersion.description: Propose a new version of an existing tool name

tools.name: publish_tool
tools.title: Publish a registry tool
tools.description: Request publication of a tested tool. Policy manual (default): the tool becomes pending_approval, a review file is written and a human must run the server's `registry approve <name>` command (`<server>.exe registry --help`; or set status=published in tool.json). Policy auto: tested tools publish immediately. Published tools appear in tools/list of every running server.

tools.name: connect_node_ports
tools.title: Connect Dynamo node ports
tools.description: Creates a wire (connector) between an output port of an upstream source node and an input port of a downstream target node in the active Dynamo workspace. [Registry tool v1, Wire, transaction=auto. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Dynamo — prefer them over execute_dynamo_code for the same task.]

sourceNodeId.description: GUID or unique name of the upstream source node providing the output

sourcePortIndex.description: 0-based index of the output port on the source node

targetNodeId.description: GUID or unique name of the downstream target node receiving the input

targetPortIndex.description: 0-based index of the input port on the target node

dryRun.description: Run the tool, then roll everything back. Use first on a model you care about.

tools.name: execute_dynamo_code
tools.title: Execute C# in Dynamo
tools.description: Runs a C# script inside Autodesk Dynamo and Revit with user privileges. Globals: dynamo (DynamoModel/DynamoViewModel), workspace (WorkspaceModel), doc (Document), ct (CancellationToken check in long loops), log(string), progress(int current, int total, string message), args (args.Str/Double/Int/Long/Bool(key, fallback), args.Obj/List(key), args.Has/Require(key)). Modifications touching Revit elements are wrapped in a Revit TransactionGroup ('MCP Dynamo: <label>'). transaction=auto commits when the script returns; none is read-only; manual manages its own Transaction. dryRun=true runs the script, then rolls back all Revit and Dynamo changes while reporting modifications. Requires the user to tick 'Allow AI Dynamo execution' in the HPDynamo MCP Bridge window inside Revit.

code.description: C# script body, max 32 KB. Forbidden: System.IO, System.Net, Process, unauthorized reflection.

transaction.description: auto (default): commits changes. none: read-only; any modification fails. manual: manages own Transaction.

dryRun.description: Run the script, then roll back all Revit elements and canvas modifications. Use first for destructive operations.

label.description: Short name for the audit log and Revit undo history. Max 64 characters.

args.description: Optional JSON object handed to the script as args. Keys are matched case-insensitively.

tools.name: run_dyn_file
tools.title: Execute a Dynamo graph (.dyn) file
tools.description: Executes a Dynamo (.dyn) graph file either on the active canvas or headlessly, applying optional parameter overrides to input nodes and extracting output values from terminal or Watch nodes. Under dryRun, element changes in Revit are rolled back via TransactionGroup. [Registry tool v1, Graph, transaction=auto. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Dynamo — prefer them over execute_dynamo_code for the same task.]

filePath.description: Absolute file path to the .dyn graph file

inputs.description: Dictionary of node names or GUIDs mapped to override values (e.g. {"SpanLength": 6000, "BarDiameter": 20})

runHeadless.description: Force headless evaluation via RevitDynamoModel even if Dynamo canvas UI is open

extractOutputs.description: Extract evaluated output values from terminal or Watch nodes after execution

dryRun.description: Run the tool, then roll everything back. Use first on a model you care about.

tools.name: inspect_node_type
tools.title: Inspect Dynamo node type
tools.description: Inspects detailed signature and port specifications of a Dynamo node type, including input ports (names, types, default values), output ports, declaring assembly, category, and documentation. [Registry tool v1, Library, transaction=none. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Dynamo — prefer them over execute_dynamo_code for the same task.]

nodeType.description: Full name, creation name, or class name of the node type to inspect (e.g. 'DSCoreNodes.Point.ByCoordinates', 'Revit.Elements.Wall.ByCurveAndLevels', 'CoreNodeModels.Watch')

tools.name: execute_designscript
tools.title: Execute DesignScript in Dynamo
tools.description: Executes DesignScript code directly within the Dynamo evaluation engine. Supports standard DesignScript syntax: geometry creation (Point.ByCoordinates, Line.ByStartPointEndPoint, Curve, Solid), code block logic, list operations, and math expressions. transaction=auto commits created elements; none is read-only evaluation. dryRun=true evaluates the code and rolls back all created Revit elements via TransactionGroup. Requires the user to tick 'Allow AI Dynamo execution' in the HPDynamo MCP Bridge window.

code.description: DesignScript code block to execute (e.g., 'pt = Point.ByCoordinates(0, 0, 0); line = Line.ByStartPointEndPoint(pt, Point.ByCoordinates(10, 0, 0));').

transaction.description: auto (default): commits geometry and elements. none: read-only evaluation. manual: manages own Transaction.

dryRun.description: Run the DesignScript and roll back all changes. Verifies geometry and output values without persisting.

label.description: Short label for tracking in audit log. Max 64 characters.

args.description: Optional JSON variables dictionary passed to the script execution environment.

tools.name: export_graph_to_image
tools.title: Export graph to image
tools.description: Export a screenshot / image rendering of the active Dynamo canvas workspace to a PNG or JPEG file on disk. Read-only. [Registry tool v1, Export, transaction=none. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Dynamo — prefer them over execute_dynamo_code for the same task.]

outputPath.description: Optional file path where the exported image will be saved (e.g. 'C:\Temp\dynamo_graph.png'). If omitted, writes to %TEMP% with a timestamp.

tools.name: test_tool
tools.title: Test a registry tool
tools.description: Run a tool's examples (or the given cases) inside the host application with dryRun — every change is rolled back — and record the outcomes. All cases passing moves a draft to tested. realRun=true commits the changes (only on a scratch model).

cases.description: Optional cases [{"title": "...", "args": {...}}]; default = the tool's examples

tools.name: manage_tool
tools.title: Deprecate, quarantine or restore a tool
tools.description: deprecate: retire a tool (never runs again until restored). quarantine: pull it from tools/list. restore: back to draft so it can be tested and published again.

annotations.title: Deprecate, quarantine or restore a tool

tools.name: get_tool
tools.title: Get a registry tool
tools.description: Full record of one stored tool: metadata, input schema, examples, C# code (optional), run statistics and recent runs.

recentRuns.description: How many recent runs to include (0–50)

tools.name: add_node_to_workspace
tools.title: Add node to Dynamo workspace
tools.description: Places a new node instance onto the active Dynamo workspace canvas at specified coordinates (X, Y), optionally setting its display name or initial value. Supports CodeBlock, standard Core nodes, and Revit nodes. [Registry tool v1, Node, transaction=auto. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Dynamo — prefer them over execute_dynamo_code for the same task.]

nodeType.description: Node creation identifier or type name (e.g. 'DSCoreNodes.Point', 'CodeBlock', 'CoreNodeModels.Watch', 'DSCore.Color.ByARGB')

x.description: Horizontal position X on the workspace canvas in pixels

y.description: Vertical position Y on the workspace canvas in pixels

name.description: Optional custom display title for the created node

initialValue.description: Optional initial value or code expression (used when creating a CodeBlock, String, or Number node)

dryRun.description: Run the tool, then roll everything back. Use first on a model you care about.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.title: Search the tool registry
tools.description: Search the registry of stored tools for this host (Revit or AutoCAD) BEFORE writing code with the execute tool (execute_revit_code / execute_autocad_code). Full-text over name, description, tags and examples, ranked by relevance × stability × status. Returns each tool's inputSchema so it can be called directly by name (published tools are real MCP tools) or through run_tool. Empty query lists tools (optionally by category).

query.description: What you want to do, in any language, e.g. 'tạo lưới trục', 'color beams by type', 'room schedule'

category.description: One of the host's categories (search_tools lists them): Architecture | Structure | MEP | Annotation | View | Data | Generic for Revit, Drawing | Layer | Block | Annotation | Layout | Data | Generic for AutoCAD

includeUnpublished.description: Also return draft / tested / pending tools (they need allowUnpublished=true in run_tool)
